tha-ap208:1.1: Udakadāyaka.] Bhuñjantaṃ samaṇaṃ disvā vippasannam anāvilaṃ / ghaṭen' odakam ādāya Siddhatthassa adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap208:2.1: Nimmalo hom' aham ajja vimalo khīṇasaṃsayo / bhave nibbattamānamhi phalaṃ nibbattate mama. // //
tha-ap208:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe udakaṃ yaṃ tadā adaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi udakadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap208:4.1: Ekasaṭṭhi ito kappe eko 'va Vimalo ahu / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap208:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Udakadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
